text: {"assertions":["A dropped frames bug in the websocket session was fixed on 2026-02-07 in the realtime/ws/session.ts file.","The dropped frames issue only occurred for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels.","The bug was reproduced by holding a socket open through a network flap.","The root cause was a race condition in lazy initialization.","Frames missing from the client sequence was the signal indicating the bug.","The fix was implemented using a double-checked lock pattern to guard the initialization.","The fix reduced p99 latency from 5.4 seconds to 730 milliseconds.","The fix was submitted as PR #7680 on the fix/dropped-frames-1 branch."]}
